events.name: Sudden Storm
events.description: A violent storm erupts without warning. The howling wind and biting cold sap your strength. Lose 1 HP.

places.name: Abandoned Camp
places.description: You stumble upon a deserted campsite with dying embers. While this card remains here you may rest to recover 2 HP (once per visit).

strangers.name: Wandering Healer
strangers.description: A robed figure offers to mend your wounds for a modest fee.
